profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, that provides cloud storage, file sharing, and collaboration tools. Its website describes the platform as offering secure storage with synced team folders, previews for more than 175 file types, and integrations with external AI platforms that allow users to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools. The company also offers a product called Dash, which it describes as a way to organize all company content in one place.

Dropbox's AI product, tracked under the name Dropbox AI, is categorized as a notes, knowledge, and meetings tool and covers document summaries, team data handling, and sharing controls. The company notes that built-in AI summaries are coming soon to its core storage product. Dropbox is also registered in the MCP server directory through a third-party server, ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, which enables searching, browsing, and reading of Dropbox files and folders by name or content.

Dropbox is a publicly traded company on the ticker DBX with SEC CIK 0001467623. Its most recently reported annual revenue, drawn from a 10-K filing for the period ending December 31, 2025, was $2,521,000,000. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
